behavior: Whole reset retains exact account and historical copies, clears authority only after storage acknowledgement, revokes signing/session context and blocks new private operations during reset.

Web nullable password authority and account archival share an IndexedDB transaction. The old window password/journal bytes are retained; updated listeners reject legacy mutation requests. Tombstone prevents password resurrection on restart.

Read-only recovery excludes automatic account reconciliation, TON pending-cipher repair and selection writes; healthy keys export with their original passwords. Retained raw record export is independent of loaded keys and refuses unsupported structured objects.

Local transfers recheck a reset revision across preparation/signing/submission; BTC/SOL serialize canonical senders and retain prior pending evidence. Signed-envelope identity is verified before pending reuse/rebroadcast.
WalletConnect reset does not wait for SDK initialization or relay disconnect. A durable generation rejects unknown late SDK topics after reset; explicit new grants await durable acknowledgement.

Recovery entry works in recovery-only, healthy Unlock, settings and empty-wallet migration states. Read-only incident warning, retry, original-password guidance and four shipped web locales remain visible and narrow layouts wrap.
